lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-linear grid posterior to the vertical branchial slits, with the largest clusters concentrated in the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity to form a matrix where high-luminance blobs are positioned at the approximate grid vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper margin to a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, low-luminance elongated object trailing the ventral-pectoral junction, likely a commensal organism.
